deductions.description: Both items were abandoned in the study — whoever left did so without time to collect anything. This was not a planned departure.
The torn note was written on Harlow's own paper, and both reference Thursday. Harlow wrote the note — or dictated it.
The drawer was forced and a document destroyed — someone searched this room looking for exactly what the note references.
The overheard voices confirmed papers were taken from this room. The torn note is what they were looking for — or what they left behind.
